mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO contracts ( contract_start_date, contract_end_date, total_budget, payment_method, contract_status, payment_status, origin_contract_url, platform_contract_url, ai_report_url, contracted_at, completed_at, cancel_reason, client_rating, client_experience, client_is_renewal_intended, freelancer_rating, freelancer_experience ) VALUES ( #{contract.contractStartDate}, #{contract.contractEndDate}, #{contract.totalBudget}, #{contract.paymentMethod}, #{contract.contractStatus}, #{contract.paymentStatus}, #{contract.originContractUrl}, #{contract.platformContractUrl}, #{contract.aiReportUrl}, #{contract.contractedAt}, #{contract.completedAt}, #{contract.cancelReason}, #{contract.clientRating}, #{contract.clientExperience}, #{contract.clientIsRenewalIntended}, #{contract.freelancerRating}, #{contract.freelancerExperience} )
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
mapper.update: UPDATE contracts SET contract_start_date = #{contract.contractStartDate}, contract_end_date = #{contract.contractEndDate}, total_budget = #{contract.totalBudget}, payment_method = #{contract.paymentMethod}, contract_status = #{contract.contractStatus}, payment_status = #{contract.paymentStatus}, origin_contract_url = #{contract.originContractUrl}, platform_contract_url = #{contract.platformContractUrl}, ai_report_url = #{contract.aiReportUrl}, completed_at = #{contract.completedAt}, cancel_reason = #{contract.cancelReason}, client_rating = #{contract.clientRating}, client_experience = #{contract.clientExperience}, client_is_renewal_intended = #{contract.clientIsRenewalIntended}, freelancer_rating = #{contract.freelancerRating}, freelancer_experience = #{contract.freelancerExperience} WHERE contract_id = #{contract.contractId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM contracts ORDER BY contract_id DESC
SELECT FROM contracts WHERE origin_contract_url LIKE #{pathPattern} ORDER BY contract_id DESC
SELECT origin_contract_url FROM contracts WHERE origin_contract_url LIKE #{pathPattern} AND contract_status != 'TERMINATED' AND origin_contract_url IS NOT NULL AND origin_contract_url != ''

SELECT c.* FROM contracts c INNER JOIN projects p ON CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.origin_contract_url, '/', 3), '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) = p.project_id WHERE p.client_id = #{clientId} AND p.project_id = #{projectId} AND c.contract_status != 'TERMINATED' AND c.origin_contract_url LIKE CONCAT('contracts/', #{clientId}, '/', #{projectId}, '/', #{freelancerId}, '/%') AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.origin_contract_url, '/', 4), '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) = #{freelancerId} ORDER BY c.contract_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.contract_id, c.contract_start_date, c.contract_end_date, c.total_budget, c.payment_method, c.contract_status, c.payment_status, c.origin_contract_url, c.platform_contract_url, c.ai_report_url, c.contracted_at, c.completed_at, c.cancel_reason, c.client_rating, c.client_experience, c.client_is_renewal_intended, c.freelancer_rating, c.freelancer_experience,
p.project_id, p.client_id as project_client_id, p.title, p.description, p.start_date, p.deadline_date, p.est_duration, p.budget, p.communicate_method, p.payment_method as project_payment_method, p.change_policy, p.max_revision_count, p.project_status, p.is_public, p.created_at as project_created_at, p.updated_at as project_updated_at, p.view_count, p.applicant_count, p.plan_url, p.file_size, p.budget_negotiable, p.duration_negotiable,
fu.user_id as freelancer_user_id, fu.login_id as freelancer_login_id, fu.email as freelancer_email, fu.password as freelancer_password, fu.refresh_token as freelancer_refresh_token, fu.user_type as freelancer_user_type, fu.status as freelancer_status, fu.name as freelancer_name, fu.phone as freelancer_phone, fu.birth_date as freelancer_birth_date, fu.profile_image_url as freelancer_profile_image_url, fu.created_at as freelancer_created_at, fu.updated_at as freelancer_updated_at,
fp.freelancer_id, fp.nickname, fp.introduction, fp.github_url, fp.website_url, fp.school_name, fp.major, fp.degree, fp.grad_status, fp.is_profile_complete,
cu.user_id as client_user_id, cu.login_id as client_login_id, cu.email as client_email, cu.password as client_password, cu.refresh_token as client_refresh_token, cu.user_type as client_user_type, cu.status as client_status, cu.name as client_name, cu.phone as client_phone, cu.birth_date as client_birth_date, cu.profile_image_url as client_profile_image_url, cu.created_at as client_created_at, cu.updated_at as client_updated_at,
cp.client_id as client_profile_client_id, cp.company_id, cp.client_type,
co.company_id as company_company_id, co.company_name, co.ceo_name, co.ceo_email, co.business_number, co.business_verified, co.industry, co.address, co.company_size, co.website_url as company_website_url, co.created_at as company_created_at FROM contracts c LEFT JOIN projects p ON c.origin_contract_url IS NOT NULL AND c.origin_contract_url LIKE 'contracts/%/%/%' AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.origin_contract_url, '/', 3), '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) = p.project_id LEFT JOIN users fu ON c.origin_contract_url IS NOT NULL AND c.origin_contract_url LIKE 'contracts/%/%/%' AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.origin_contract_url, '/', 4), '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) = fu.user_id AND fu.user_type = 'FREELANCER' LEFT JOIN freelancer_profiles fp ON fu.user_id = fp.freelancer_id LEFT JOIN users cu ON p.client_id = cu.user_id AND cu.user_type = 'CLIENT' LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON cu.user_id = cp.client_id LEFT JOIN companies co ON cp.company_id = co.company_id WHERE c.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT project_id as projectId, client_id as clientId, title, description, start_date as startDate, deadline_date as deadlineDate, est_duration as estDuration, budget, communicate_method as communicateMethod, payment_method as paymentMethod, change_policy as changePolicy, max_revision_count as maxRevisionCount, project_status as projectStatus, is_public as isPublic, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, view_count as viewCount, applicant_count as applicantCount, plan_url as planUrl, file_size as fileSize, budget_negotiable as budgetNegotiable, duration_negotiable as durationNegotiable FROM projects WHERE project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT project_id as projectId, client_id as clientId, title, description, start_date as startDate, deadline_date as deadlineDate, est_duration as estDuration, budget, communicate_method as communicateMethod, payment_method as paymentMethod, change_policy as changePolicy, max_revision_count as maxRevisionCount, project_status as projectStatus, is_public as isPublic, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, view_count as viewCount, applicant_count as applicantCount, plan_url as planUrl, file_size as fileSize, budget_negotiable as budgetNegotiable, duration_negotiable as durationNegotiable FROM projects WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND project_status = 'READY'
SELECT u.user_id as id, u.name, u.email FROM project_applications pa INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = pa.freelancer_id WHERE pa.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY pa.applied_at DESC

SELECT c.contract_id, c.contract_status, c.payment_status, c.total_budget, c.created_at, p.title AS project_title, u.name AS freelancer_name FROM contracts c JOIN project_applications pa ON c.contract_id = pa.application_id JOIN projects p ON pa.project_id = p.project_id JOIN users u ON pa.freelancer_id = u.user_id WHERE p.client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
